text.tspan: AWS storage options: pick by data type and who mounts it
Databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ...): for specific workloads, usually with indexing and querying, not a place to keep files
• "Windows / SMB / NTFS / Active Directory" → FSx for Windows · "HPC, ML, Lustre, read S3 as a file system" → FSx for Lustre
• "NFS + SMB + iSCSI, move NetApp/NAS" → FSx for ONTAP · "move ZFS" → FSx for OpenZFS · "Linux NFS shared, POSIX" → EFS
• "on-premises apps see S3 as files/volumes/tapes" → Storage Gateway · "partners send files over SFTP" → Transfer Family · "scheduled copy" → DataSync
